views.front: Three seat and back covers have visible tailored loft while preserving the low green sofa profile.
views.rear: Rear rail and cushions remain supported and continuous across the sofa.
views.detail: Subtle grain and restrained upholstery puckering replace the flatter source pads without coarse basket weave.
views.underside: The closed base and four metal legs remain attached.
views.clay: Separate cushion boxing and softer profiles are clear in clay; the low arms remain simple.
